# Estimator

Estimator is a free online estimation library — construction material estimators (concrete, roofing, flooring, tile), project cost estimators (remodels, decks, driveways, HVAC) and the full set of 154 money, health and everyday calculators. Estimator calculates quantities, coverage and costs; results are planning estimates, not quotes.

Made for contractors, DIYers, homeowners and the trades — plus anyone who reaches for the money and everyday tools.

All 154 calculators are free, with no account or sign-up. Every calculator shows its formula or method and at least one worked example.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://estimator.website/): all 154 calculators, organized by category.
- [Embed these calculators](https://estimator.website/embed.html): put any of the 154 Estimator calculators on your own site for free — no account, no attribution required.
- [Partnerships](https://estimator.website/partnerships.html): the network Estimator belongs to, and how to partner with us.
- [Creator ROI Hub — Earnings, Sponsorship & Fee Calculators](https://estimator.website/creator-roi-calculators.html): The Creator ROI Hub: free calculators for people who publish for a living — YouTube and TikTok earnings, sponsorship rates, payment fees and AI API costs, with honest ranges and the math shown.
